falseSynonyms.zh: 理解不等於同意 understand 只表示明白某人的意思，不代表贊成。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I understand your argument, but I do not agree with it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 喜歡不等於同意 like 表示喜好；一個人可以喜歡某人，但不同意他的看法。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I like him, but I do not agree with his opinion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 服從不等於同意 obey 表示按照命令行事，即使心裡並不贊成。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She obeyed the instruction, but she did not agree with it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 承認不等於同意 admit 表示承認某件事是真的或承認某個事實，不等於贊成某人的立場。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He admitted the mistake, but he did not agree with the proposed solution.

falseSynonyms.zh: 接受不一定等於意見相同 accept 可以表示接受現實、條件或安排；agree 更常表示看法一致或同意做某事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She accepted the decision even though she did not agree with it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 批准不一定等於單純同意 approve 常帶有正式批准或認可意味；agree 範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The manager agreed with the idea. The director formally approved the plan.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性不同 agreement 是名詞；agree 是動詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They reached an agreement. They agreed on the final price.

falseSynonyms.zh: 共識不等於動詞「同意」 consensus 是名詞，表示一群人形成共同意見。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The group reached a consensus. The members agreed on the main issue.
